authorized_interfaces: Codespaces forwarded port 3000, visibility private only

authorization.authority_basis: Self-owned Juice Shop application instance deployed in a private GitHub Codespace; GitHub and Codespaces infrastructure are excluded
permitted_techniques: Manual browser, HTTP, and API testing
Automated testing and regression tests limited to 2 requests per second with concurrency 1
explicit_exclusions: Every unlisted host, interface, port, API, account, and dependency
Outbound callbacks or SSRF to real external services
stop_conditions: Observed target or environment differs from this record
Port 3000 becomes public or another interface is exposed
Real data or a third-party interaction is encountered
Unexpected instability or unintended impact occurs
cleanup_obligations: Stop and remove the laboratory container
Close port forwarding and verify no listener remains
Remove synthetic accounts, uploads, test data, and temporary credentials
Sanitize, hash, review, retain, or securely delete evidence according to the authorization record
